\section{Proof certificates and independent verification}\label{sec:certificate}

The supplement contains two executable proof kernels.  Both reconstruct the
block from the definitions in Section~\ref{sec:block}; neither reads a stored
matrix.  The primary verifier uses arbitrary-precision integers and rational
numbers.  It checks $d_1d_0=0$, performs exact elimination over $\mathbb Q$,
computes the lexicographic tree and cotree, proves the $1/25$ floor by rational
$LDL^{\mathsf T}$, and propagates all analytic constants as fractions.

The independent verifier uses different arithmetic mechanisms.  It computes
ranks modulo $2$, $101$, and $1000003$, and applies fraction-free Bareiss
elimination to the integer matrix $25H-\Id$.  Positivity of every leading
principal minor supplies an independent Sylvester certificate.  The two
verifiers share the declarative cubical constructor but do not share a rank or
spectral algorithm.

\begin{center}
\begin{tabular}{@{}lll@{}}
\toprule
Claim & Primary kernel & Independent kernel\\
\midrule
Cell counts and $d_1d_0=0$ & integer construction & reconstructed input\\
Ranks $80,136,17$ & rational elimination & three modular fields\\
Floor $H\succeq1/25$ & rational $LDL^{\mathsf T}$ & Bareiss/Sylvester\\
Nonlinear budgets & exact fractions & analytic formulas audited separately\\
Tree sensitivity & lexicographic and reverse trees & lexicographic tree\\
Orientation sensitivity & sign congruence test & invariant input convention\\
\bottomrule
\end{tabular}
\end{center}

The primary spectral pivot digest is
\begin{center}
\texttt{5f0d0c8d81799f4ec07de98f97719fef2aa73e954b7265e408022df22ebb501a}.
\end{center}
The verifier records Python version, exact parameters, selected rows, tree
edges, pivot hashes, and a binary pass/fail field.  Its largest rational pivot
uses $653$ bits.  Binary floating point is not used in a theorem decision.

Eleven tests cover the positive path and hostile inputs: excessive radius,
excessive heat time, an alternate spanning tree, link-orientation sign changes,
and independent arithmetic.  Appendix~\ref{app:certificate} specifies the
trusted kernel and Appendix~\ref{app:reproducibility} gives exact commands.
